name: Touhou Luna Nights: 5 Year Anniversary Limited Edition
summary:
Touhou Luna Nights: 5 Year Anniversary Limited Edition - Switch - Touhou Luna Nights: 5 Year Anniversary Limited Edition Includes: the Physical Game, Anniversary Collector’s Box, Instruction Booklet, Steelbook, Double CD Original Soundtrack, Serialised Certificate of Authenticity and 3 Alternative Inlays.

Step into the enchanting world of Touhou Luna Nights! Experience a Metroidvania adventure that combines the captivating universe of the Touhou Project with unique gameplay mechanics. As Sakuya Izayoi, the time-stopping maid, explore a mysterious world filled with danger and secrets. Utilise the innovative time stop ability, master the graze system, and uncover the mysteries behind Remilia Scarlet's strange new world. With stunning pixel art and fluid animations, this game offers both fans and newcomers a thrilling 2D action experience that’s as beautiful as it is challenging.
